- You will know what a Python module is
- You will be able to include a module in your program with the `import` statement
content.CAS:
# Objetivos de aprendizaje

- Sabrás qué es un módulo de Python

content.EUS:

- Python modulu bat zer den jakingo duzu

import unittest
from fractions import Fraction
class TestFractions(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_run(self):
        res = fractionate(3)
        self.assertEqual(len(res), 3, 'Should return 3 fractions | Debería devolver 3 fracciones | 3 zatiki itzuli beharko lituzke')
        self.assertEqual(res[0], Fraction(1, 3), 'Should be 1/3 | Debería ser 1/3 | 1/3 izan beharko litzateke')
